entries.name: battery_status2
entries.help_text: Battery status bit field. The Overview page decodes the bits it knows into text such as balancing, and keeps the raw code visible for any bit it does not recognise.

entries.name: power_mng_battery_power
entries.description: Battery discharge power [W] (power_mng.battery_power, 0x1156DFD0); the protocol does not identify it as a setpoint or specify its relationship to g_sync.p_acc_lp

entries.name: battery_current
entries.description: Battery current [A] (battery.current, 0x21961B58); measuring point, sign convention and filter characteristics are not specified by the protocol
entries.help_text: Battery current as the device reports it. The protocol specifies neither the measuring point, nor the sign convention, nor the filtering.

entries.name: energy_e_grid_feed_year
entries.description: Year energy grid feed-in; the protocol defines no sign, devices may report negative values (passed through unchanged)

entries.name: display_struct_brightness
entries.help_text: Brightness of the device display, from 0 to 255.

entries.name: energy_e_grid_feed_day
entries.description: Day energy grid feed-in; the protocol defines no sign, devices may report negative values (passed through unchanged)

entries.name: battery_power
entries.description: Battery power [W] (g_sync.p_acc_lp, 0x400F015B), positive on discharge according to the protocol example; measuring point and filter characteristics are not specified
entries.help_text: Power at the battery, positive on discharge according to the protocol example. Battery power, voltage and current are separate device variables, so the power need not equal voltage times current.

entries.name: energy_e_grid_feed_total
entries.description: Total energy grid feed-in; the protocol defines no sign, devices may report negative values (passed through unchanged)

entries.name: inverter_state
entries.help_text: Current state of the inverter state machine, reported as one of its labelled states such as standby, insulation check, power check or feed in.

entries.name: energy_e_grid_feed_month
entries.description: Month energy grid feed-in; the protocol defines no sign, devices may report negative values (passed through unchanged)

entries.name: battery_voltage
entries.description: Battery voltage [V] (battery.voltage, 0x65EED11B); measuring point and filter characteristics are not specified by the protocol
entries.help_text: Battery voltage as the device reports it. A separate variable from battery power and current; the protocol does not specify the measuring point or the filtering.

entries.name: battery_soc_target
entries.description: Battery SOC target, device wire value is a ratio 0..1 scaled to percent
entries.help_text: State of charge the device aims for. Read and written in percent; the device itself holds a ratio from 0 to 1, which the gateway converts in both directions.

entries.name: com_service
entries.description: COM service action variable; writing triggers an action in the device
entries.help_text: Service action. Writing a code triggers the matching action in the device, for example flashing parameters or starting a battery commission. The destructive codes 6 (erase parameters flash) and 11 (erase datalog) are not writable in the shipped allowlist. Reset the value to 0 before repeating an action.

entries.name: power_mng_bat_calib_reqularity
entries.description: Battery calibration interval in days (power_mng.bat_calib_reqularity; the misspelling is the device's); not converted to seconds
entries.help_text: Number of days the device waits between two battery calibrations. The value stays a day count and is not converted to seconds; the misspelled device name is kept on purpose.

entries.name: battery_soc
entries.description: Battery state of charge as ratio 0..1
entries.help_text: Current battery state of charge as a ratio from 0 to 1, so 0.5 means 50 percent.

entries.name: pas_period
entries.help_text: Period of the device's periodic value registration. Writing it can change periodic polling.

entries.name: power_mng_bat_next_calib_date
entries.description: Next battery calibration as Unix time in seconds (power_mng.bat_next_calib_date)
entries.help_text: Time of the next battery calibration as Unix time in seconds. The Overview page shows it as the next calibration date.

entries.name: net_slave_data
entries.description: Slave device structure of the plant network (diagnostics only)

entries.name: power_mng_amp_hours
entries.description: Battery energy in Ah (power_mng.amp_hours, 0xFBD94C1F); not the battery capacity, see battery_ah_capacity
